 Coram:Honourable Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi
 Date : 06/03/2025
 Oral Order

1. By filing instant petition under Section 447 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the petitioner has prayed for transfer of case arising out of an FIR being C.R. No.11191030230023/2023 registered with Paschim Mahila Police Station, Ahmedabad.

2. Heard learned advocate, Mr. Sanat Pandya for the applicant, learned APP Mr. Rohan Shah for the respondent no.1 and learned Senior Counsel, Mr. N.D. Nanavaty assisted by learned advocate, Mr.
Rahul R. Dholakia for the respondent no.2.
3.

Learned advocate, Mr. Pandya submitted that the applicant is the original complainant, who had filed FIR against accused and then after subsequently, on the basis of the registration of FIR, the Investigating Officer commenced NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18639/2024 ORDER DATED:
06/03/2025 undefined investigation and ultimately at the end of it, the concerned Investigating Officer concerned filed chargesheet.

He submitted that in fact, at the time of registration of the FIR,

sentences.text: the applicant was residing at Ahmedabad and she filed FIR at Paschim Mahila Police Station on 03.05.2023 for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 294(b), 506(2), 313, 315, 316 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act but after registration of the FIR, the applicant shifted to Gandhidham and at present also, she is residing there at her parental home at Gandhidham.

He submitted that however, the applicant is facing serious threats at the hands of the accused persons and, therefore, she does not wish to appear before the court at Ahmedabad and she has also instituted another proceeding against the accused persons before the court at Gandhidham.

He submitted that the applicant is stationed as Gandhidham and is suffering from serious ailments and it is practically not feasible to appear and attend the court proceedings at Ahmedabad, therefore, the present application is filed with a sole intent to transfer the said proceeding from the court at Ahmedabad to the court at Gandhidham because the accused have to attend other proceeding pending before the court at Gandhidham.

Learned advocate has drawn attention towards the medical papers of the applicant produced on record and submitted that it clearly goes on to show the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18639/2024 ORDER DATED:
06/03/2025 undefined medical ailments of the accused and because of which, it is practically not feasible for her to attend the proceeding at Ahmedabad.
It is, therefore, urged that the present application may be allowed.

4. On the other hand, learned Senior Counsel, Mr. Nanavati has opposed the grant of relief in favour of the applicant and submitted that it is an admitted position of fact that the so-called incident has occurred within the periphery of Gurugram, Haryana, for which, FIR has been lodged at Ahmedabad, that too, after huge delay and pursuant thereto, criminal proceeding is pending before the court of learned Magistrate, Ahmedabad, where after submission of the chargesheet, yet the case is not committed to the court of Sessions.
He submitted that as can be seen from the FIR itself, the accused are resident of Gurugram, Haryana and incident has taken place there but FIR has been lodged at Ahmedabad.

He submitted that FIR has been lodged against total five accused persons,
out of which, two accused have approached this Court by filing quashing petition and the Coordinate Bench of this Court has directed the concerned IO not to file chargesheet against them and out of remaining three accused, one has also filed quashing petition, wherein the Coordinate Bench of this Court has granted stay against further proceedings.

He submitted that in fact, it is only when the evidence of the applicant will NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18639/2024 ORDER DATED:
06/03/2025 undefined have to be recorded, at that point of time, the applicant will have to remain present once and, thereafter, she need not have to remain present.

He further submitted that so far as the aspect of ailments is concerned, it is settled proposition of law that she can appear before the court concerned through virtual mode and in the present scenario, such facility is available in all courts of State of Gujarat and, therefore, physical presence of the applicant is not required.

It is,
therefore, urged that the present application may be rejected.

5. In view of the rival submissions canvassed by learned advocates for the parties, it is found out that the applicant has lodged FIR against the accused persons and in connection with the same, criminal case is pending before the court of learned Magistrate, Ahmedabad and it is an admitted position of fact that, after submission of the chargesheet, the case is not committed to the court of Sessions.
Further as stated by learned Senior Counsel appearing for the accused, FIR has been lodged against total five accused, out of which, because of the order of the Coordinate Bench of this Court,

sentences.text: 2 chargesheet has not been filed against two accused, whereas in case of one of the co-accused, the trial is stayed by the Coordinate Bench of this Court.

6. Be that as it may, the ground for seeking transfer of case is on two ground i.e. one on account of NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/18639/2024 ORDER DATED: 06/03/2025 undefined serious ailments of the applicant and second one is of threats being administered by the accused.

However considering the facts of the case, those two grounds are not found to be valid in view of the fact that as per the present scenario in the courts of State of Gujarat, more particularly after pandemic situation, the Courts have adopted practice of video conferencing, wherein party concern, where his/her physical presence is not required, can appear before the Court through virtual mode and the said facility can be availed by the applicant.
7. Thus in the facts of the present case, I am not found any merit in the present petition and same deserves to be rejected and is hereby rejected.
Notice is discharged.

(DIVYESH A. JOSHI, J.) Gautam Tina @ Twinkle Shivam Shingh Rana vs State Of Gujarat on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111156200/
